bits of milliseconds since midnight UT. One use of these timestamps is
described by Mills [5].
The Originate Timestamp is the time the sender last touched the
timestamp before sending it, the Receive Timestamp is the time the echoer
tfirst touched it on receipt, and the Transmit Timestamp is the time
the echoer last touched the message on sending it.
